name: Product Launch
tagline: Your product goes in, a polished launch video with the real app on screen comes out.
description: The 20–60 second launch video SaaS teams post on X: a hook that names the pain, the name landing on the beat drop, your real app shown working in floating windows, proof, and a clean end card. Everything is cut to one music grid and reads with the sound off. Only real screens and real facts, never a mocked interface.
bring: Your product: a link, the app to record, or screenshots and recordings
Who it's for and where you'll post it
Optional: logo, brand colors, a music track or a voiceover script
get: A 20–60 s launch video (16:9, or 9:16 for Reels) with music and sound effects

needs.name: Launch music script and starter scene
Hyperframes (or your project's video tool), Python 3 and ffmpeg
Music, if you want a real track

steps: Collect real screens, recordings and facts from your product
Plan the frames on a music beat and agree on the story
Design each frame so every piece lands on a beat
Make the music and sound effects for this exact cut
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
